It may offer extension points (pre-commit setup, generated code and config), but those can run once the venv exists. It should stay small and focused on the early bootstrap and then hand over to the tools inside the venv. I want to find it, review it, contribute to it, or confirm that the niche is still empty.

Focused on the early bootstrap only and small; later steps may be handed over to tools in the venv
Open source (the asker wants to review it and contribute)
preferences: Extension points such as pre-commit setup and code or config generation (after the venv exists)
